nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon History KP: product Search API.

buyBoxIsAmazon.description: Whether the Buy Box seller is Amazon.

buyBoxIsFBA.description: Whether the Buy Box is FBA.

categoriesExclude.description: Subcategory IDs to exclude, up to 50.

categoriesExcludeNames.description: Names of subcategories to be excluded, up to 50; used when `categoriesExclude` is empty, supporting full category paths.

categoriesInclude.description: Subcategory IDs to include, up to 50; only include products listed directly in these subcategories.

categoriesIncludeNames.description: Subcategory names to include, up to 50; used when `categoriesInclude` is empty, supports full category paths separated by `:` or `›`.

history.description: Whether the return value contains historical data/historical sales volume: `1`=obtain, `0`=not obtain.

keyword.description: Title keyword; case-insensitive, spaces represent word segmentation AND, when the keyword itself contains spaces, it should be wrapped in double quotes, and the prefix `-` is supported for exclusion; `&` will be replaced by spaces, with a maximum of 50 keywords and a maximum of 1000 characters.

perPage.description: The maximum number of results returned per page, minimum 50, maximum 100.

productType.description: Product Types: `0`=Standard Product, `1`=Downloadable Product, `2`=Ebook, `5`=Variant Parent ASIN.

rating.description: Whether to obtain rating information: `1`=obtain, `0`=not obtain.

rootCategoryNames.description: Root category name, up to 50; used when `rootCategory` is empty, the system automatically searches for the corresponding category ID.

singleVariation.description: Only one variant is returned; when set to `true`, only one variant is returned for multi-variant products.

sort.description: Maximum of 3 collations; each contains `{"fieldName":"...","sortDirection":"asc\|desc"}`. Sortable fields: `availableDate`, `currentSales`, `monthlySold`, `currentRating`, `currentCountReviews`, `currentBuyBoxShipping`, `currentNew`.

srAvgMonth.description: Historical sales ranking month, format `YYYYMM`, within the last 36 months.
